description: This file is a Java test class for the RabbitMQ client actor within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically testing connection handling, reconnections, message flow, and error scenarios for the RabbitMQ integration.

classes.name: RabbitMQClientActorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the RabbitMQ client actor in different scenarios like connection handling, reconnection, message availability, and error conditions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the static ActorSystem and connection object before all tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after all tests are complete.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up mock behaviors before each individual test.

methods.name: invalidTargetFormatThrowsConnectionConfigurationInvalidException
methods.description: Tests that invalid target format in connection configuration throws the expected exception.

methods.name: testExceptionDuringConnectionFactoryCreation
methods.description: Tests handling when creating the connection factory throws an exception.

methods.name: testConnectionHandling
methods.description: Verifies basic connection and disconnection procedures.

methods.name: testReconnectionHandling
methods.description: Simulates a connection loss and verifies that reconnection logic creates new channels and processes messages correctly after reconnect.

methods.name: verifyPublishOnChannel
methods.description: Helper method to verify message publishing on a channel.

methods.name: sendOutboundSignal
methods.description: Helper method to simulate sending an outbound signal through the actor.

methods.name: sendInboundModifyThingProtocolMessage
methods.description: Simulates receiving an inbound ModifyThing protocol message.

methods.name: testConnectionWithoutPublisherHandling
methods.description: Tests behavior when connection has no targets and therefore no publisher/consumer setup.

methods.name: testReconnection
methods.description: Repeatedly opens and closes the connection to test reconnection logic.

methods.name: sendCommandDuringInit
methods.description: Ensures that command sent during initialization results in a connection being established.

methods.name: sendConnectCommandWhenAlreadyConnected
methods.description: Verifies that sending a connect command when already connected is handled gracefully.

methods.name: sendDisconnectWhenAlreadyDisconnected
methods.description: Verifies that disconnecting when already disconnected behaves correctly.

methods.name: testCloseConnectionFails
methods.description: Tests the close connection flow, handling potential failures.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Overrides base method to provide a test-specific connection configuration.

methods.name: createClientActor
methods.description: Factory method to create actor Props for the RabbitMQ client actor.

methods.name: getClientActorProps
methods.description: Helper to assemble Props with specific connection and factory configuration.

methods.name: getActorSystem
methods.description: Returns the ActorSystem used for testing.
